New, and suddenly everywhere in Night City's clubs. Fangs, night eyes and a spare heart that lets you get back up after they've closed the lid. It's Biotechnica's way of selling immortality without promising anything.

Package: FantaForm
Humanity Loss: 22
Includes: Blood Pump, Cybereye ×2 w/ LL/IR/UV ×2, Scar Coalescer, Second Heart, SuperKidney, Toxin Binders, Vampyres

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
